subject: executor: support semi join (#57658)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent: enables HashJoinV2 for `logicalop.SemiJoin` in planner and implements executor support via new `semiJoinProbe` + shared `baseSemiJoin` (including left-build scan-row-table path), plus small supporting utilities (`chunk.CopyRows`, queue resize helper) and a refactor of outer join row-table scan init. Checked semi-join SQL semantics (existence, duplicate preservation, null-as-non-match), other-condition evaluation behavior, used-flag marking + scan partitioning, spill/sel handling, and 0-column/virtual-row chunk handling; no plausible Blocker/High issues found in the touched executor/planner behavior.
